summary.title: BCPP Database
summary.abstract: The BCPP database is a large epidemiological prospective cohort study dataset encompassing 1,284 newly diagnosed bladder cancer patients and 252 non-bladder cancer controls from the UK. The database integrates comprehensive baseline clinical and lifestyle data, over five years of median follow-up, and multi-omic profiling—including genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, and digital pathology—derived from pre-treatment tumour, blood, and urine samples.

documentation.description:
The Bladder Cancer Prognosis Program (BCPP) database is a comprehensive, clinically linked multi-omic resource comprising 1,284 newly diagnosed bladder cancer patients and 252 non-bladder cancer controls from the UK. It integrates extensive baseline demographic and lifestyle records with over five years of median follow-up data, paired with high-quality genomic, transcriptomic, proteomic, and histopathological profiles derived from pre-treatment tumour, blood, and urine samples.

### Clinical and Demographic Overview
* **Indication:** Bladder cancer ranging from early to advanced stages.
* **Geography:** United Kingdom.
* **Patient Cohort:** 1,284 bladder cancer patients (1,009 NMIBC, 275 MIBC) and 252 non-bladder cancer patients, totalling 1,536 patient records.
* **Sex Distribution:** Approximately 78% Male, 22% Female.
* **Tumour Grades:** Grade 1 (277), Grade 2 (379), Grade 3 (604), Unknown (24).
* **Tumour Stages:** pTa (657), pTis (14), pT1 (330), pT2+ (275).
* **Treatments Tracked:** TURBT, Cystectomy, Re-resection, BCG, Intravesical Chemotherapy (single/course), Systemic Chemotherapy, and Radiotherapy.

### Curated Clinical Data Scope
* **Baseline Data:** Age at enrolment/diagnosis, gender, TNM stage, tumour grade, size of largest tumour, number of primary tumours, smoking status, medical history, dietary intake, and family history.
* **Treatment Data:** Records include BCG administration (start date, doses), intravesical chemotherapy regimens, and TURBT.
* **Follow-up Data:** Median follow-up exceeds 5 years. Documents time to recurrence in bladder, progression to MIBC, mortality status, and survival data up to 2018.

### Multi-Omic Profiling & Sample Analytics
**Genomics:**
* Targeted DNAseq (23 commonest BC mutations) via Illumina Novaseq (FASTQ) on 956 tumour and 346 urine samples.
* Whole exome sequencing (DNAseq) on 101 normal samples via Illumina NextSeq 1000 (FASTQ).
* Genome-wide CNVs via Affymetrix OncoScan (.tsv) on 214 tumour and 8 urine samples.
* HPV 16/18 and BKV/JCV genomic DNA via qPCR (.csv) on 685 tumour samples.
* Genome-wide germline SNPs via Illumina Infinium OmniExpress-24 array on 780 blood samples.

**Transcriptomics (Tumour Samples):**
* Whole transcriptome short-read RNAseq via Illumina NextSeq 1000 (FASTQ) on 89 samples.
* Targeted long-read RNAseq (20 cancer genes) via PacBio Sequel II (.xlsx) on 64 samples.
* Paired long-read and short-read RNAseq via Oxford Nanopore (FASTQ) on 12 samples.

**Proteomics & Biomarkers:**
* MALDI-TOF-MS via Bruker Ultraflextreme (.csv) on 878 urine samples.
* Midkine ELISA on 572 urine samples.
* HAI-1/EpCAM/EGFR ELISAs on 961-990 urine samples.
* Olink Oncology, Inflammation, Neurology, CVS II & III panels on 90 serum samples.

**Epigenetics & Digital Pathology (Tumour Samples):**
* Genome-wide methylation via Illumina 450k BeadChip array (IDAT) on 93 samples.
* Immunohistochemistry (IL-17A, PD-L1, PD-L2, B7H4) on 95-153 samples.
* ~900 digitised H&E-stained tissue microarrays (Aperio) plus IHC for FGFR3, EGFR, pRB, TP53, Ki-67, VEGF, CK20 on 993 samples (includes unstained controls).

### Data Access & Licensing
* **Commercial Rights:** Cancer Research Horizons holds exclusive commercial rights to the database.
* **Licensing Terms:** Access is non-exclusive, solely for approved purposes, and typically granted via 3-year time-limited licences.
* **IP Ownership:** Any intellectual property generated is owned by the applicant company unless established as a collaboration with CRH.
* **Access Mechanism:** Data transfer is managed securely using Globus. Applications require a detailed study proposal specifying data subsets and patient benefit, subject to review by the BCPP Data Access Committee.
